scope: Independent review of v85 storage, energy, fields and planned/offline progression

findings.status: Fixed by production agent; independent follow-up code review confirms capacity floor and matching catalog current/next values.
findings.reason: Vault cost grows by 2 per level; storage grows by exp(20/33), so eventually the next vault upgrade cannot be mined into its own warehouse.
findings.suggestion: Keep prices, add a storage floor sufficient for the next vault upgrade, bounded by existing MAX_RESOURCE. Legal overflow delivery already bypasses the mining cap.

findings.status: Fixed: exact v84 timing before economy85_from; v85 timing after epoch. Real v84 pending snapshot replay: 31/31 checks passed.
findings.reason: Offline replay before economy85_from starts previously pending/unpaid jobs with v85 timing. Already paid/running jobs keep exact duration and completion timestamps.
findings.suggestion: Explicitly accept applying new timing to all pending jobs, or preserve pre-epoch timing during offline replay.

verified_by_review: Basic laboratory level 2 and all first vault costs fit in the initial 10000 per-resource warehouse, so no first-vault circular dependency.
Production caps each resource separately; pre-existing, delivered and refunded stock above cap is preserved and remains spendable.
Per-resource production resumes when spending lowers stock below capacity.
Planned batch cost is checked as a full batch; impossible mining forecast creates no wake-up spin.
Blocked pending order can be reordered/removed; pending lane does not prevent a manually started warehouse upgrade.
Mining and affordability forecasting use historical energy/storage rules before economy85_from and split at migration epochs.
Field migration triples once, marks each planet, and never lowers total fields below existing levels plus paid queue reservations.
Existing building levels, running queue timestamps, research and fleets are not overwritten by the fields migration.
Khar NPC retains pre85 energy and resource production rules.
New energy formula preserves racial ratios, research reductions, rare-planet power bonus and Dyson supply.

checks.new_migration_tests: Not duplicated: production agent owns actual84 snapshot migration validation
checks.historical_pending_integration: PASS: 31/31 checks; 3 races, 9 paid projects, 45 unpaid plans, 3600s offline; source84 comparison and post-epoch transition.

reviewer_mutations: Historical timing branch added to app._project_timing and ogame_economy.project_timing after root authorization. All other storage/energy changes owned by production agent.
